fusions.name: Sun-Heated Lunge
fusions.desc: A lunge that deals 30 damage, is always a critical hit, and leaves the target 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Shed-Tail Sweep
fusions.desc: A low sweep that deals 8 damage to everything within 3 tiles ahead of you. Also costs 5% of your maximum health.

fusions.name: Cold-Blooded Wind-Up
fusions.desc: After holding still for 1.5 seconds, your damage rises by 35% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Basking Edge
fusions.desc: During the day, you deal 12% more damage.
